question: Ajmer became the suba headquarters under the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ajmer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ajmer **was ruled by the great Raja Prithvi Chauhan the last Hindu king of Delhi, until his defeat in 1192.
 
• in **1556 Ajmer finally came under the Mughal Emperor**, Akbar who used it as the headquarters for his vitally important operations in Rajasthan.
 
• The Ajmer Subah was one of the original **12 subahs** that comprised the Mughal Empire after the administrative reform by Akbar
 
• Mughal patronage of the city of Ajmer in the 16th century through the support of local Sufi shrines (such as one dedicated to Moinuddin Chishti)
 
• The first British Ambassador, Sir Thomas Roe, had a historic meeting with Emperor Jahangir in 1615 in Ajmer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pallava Dynasty**

 
 
• The Pallava Dynasty rules most of the Southern part of India. 
 
• Simha Vishnu was the founder of the Pallava Dynasty.
 
• Kanchipuram was the capital of the Pallava Dynasty.
 
 
 
• **Chola Dynasty**
 
 
• **​**It was founded by Vijayalaya.
 
• The Greatest Chola ruler was Rajaraja and Rajendra 1
